revenue.source: Stellantis FY2024 Supplemental Info by Activity (FY2023, FY2024 net revenues) and FY2025 press release / 20-F (SEC acc. 0001605484-26-000019): EUR m

operating_income.source: IFRS Operating income/(loss): FY2024 press release (2024, 2023) and FY2025 press release/20-F (2025, includes EUR 25.4bn unusual charges). EUR m

d_and_a.source: Industrial activities D&A per FY2024 and FY2025 results presentations (consistent with industrial capex line). Consolidated CF D&A is 7,549/7,226/6,981 (SEC supplemental 0001605484-26-000023). EUR m

capex.source: Industrial capital expenditures (incl. capitalized R&D) per FY2024 and FY2025 results presentations (AGM 2025 results deck). Consolidated capex not found. EUR m

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 guidance of mid-single-digit net revenue increase (FY2025 press release), H2 2025 growth +10%; then fading toward GDP-like growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 reported EBIT margin is distorted by EUR 25.4bn unusual charges (AOI margin -0.5%); FY2024 reported 2.4%, FY2023 11.8%. 5% reflects partial recovery to mid-cycle, below management's mid-term ambitions; reviewer to challenge.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: blended statutory rate across Italy/France/US/other (~24-28%).

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 6.3% of revenue, FY2024 8.2%; declining as launch wave ends, 5.5% steady state, still above D&A.

wacc.source: Assumption: cyclical autos, captive finance leverage, EUR risk-free ~3% + beta ~1.3 x ERP ~5% ; no market data retrieved.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run inflation/nominal GDP for mature auto industry.

net_debt.source: FY2025 press release (SEC acc. 0001605484-26-000019): consolidated debt 45,947 - cash 30,146 - financial securities 1,362 = 14,439 EUR m. Includes financial services debt; split of lease liabilities within debt not verified.

diluted_shares.source: FY2025 20-F Note 29: weighted average diluted shares 2,886,684 thousand (no dilution as FY2025 was a loss), in millions.
